name: arda_places_ta
note: Latitudes are Tolkien's: one sentence on his son's General Map puts Hobbiton at the latitude of Oxford, and the archive's own frame -- scaled from its drawn scale bar and not from his notes -- then reproduces his other three latitudes to within 0.3, 1.4 and 2.7 degrees. LONGITUDES ARE NOT HIS: he named no meridian, so Hobbiton is put on Oxford's and the rest follow from the frame. His one east-west figure DISAGREES -- he wrote that Minas Tirith lies 900 miles east of Hobbiton and the frame makes it 789, twelve per cent short -- which is the measure of how much less a longitude here is worth than a latitude.
